metadata.summary: Rossa Ryan has been called up to partner Constitution Hill for his Italian mission on Sunday in the Gran Premio del Jockey Club.
metadata.content: Constitution Hill: Rossa Ryan to partner Nicky Henderson's star at San Siro | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Constitution Hill: Rossa Ryan to partner Nicky Henderson's star at San Siro Arc-winning rider Rossa Ryan is set to become the fifth jockey to partner Constitution Hill when he makes his first international foray in the Gran Premio del Jockey Club at San Siro. Tuesday 20 October 2026 17:05, UK Image: Rossa Ryan Rossa Ryan has been called up to partner Constitution Hill for his Italian mission on Sunday in the Gran Premio del Jockey Club. Trainer Nicky Henderson had intimated on Sunday that Oisin Murphy would be reunited with the 2023 Champion Hurdle winner having ridden him to his first win on the Flat at Southwell in February, but there has been a change of plan. With plenty of rain due in Italy it looks as if Constitution Hill's back-up option at Newbury in Saturday's St Simon Stakes will be just that, with everything pointing towards an outing at San Siro. "It's a bit of a mad one," Ryan told Sky Sports Racing at Yarmouth on Tuesday. metadata.summary: Christian Horner says Mercedes and Toto Wolff are finding life in Formula 1 "easier" without the former Red Bull team principal.
metadata.content: Christian Horner says Toto Wolff and Mercedes are finding life 'easier' without him in Formula 1 | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Christian Horner says Toto Wolff and Mercedes are finding life 'easier' without him in Formula 1 Christian Horner discussed his rivalry with Toto Wolff and was quizzed on when he could return to Formula 1 in an exclusive interview with Sky Sports News; watch every session of the United States GP in Austin from Friday evening, live on Sky Sports F1 Tuesday 20 October 2026 15:29, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Christian Horner explains the reasons behind why he left Red Bull Racing Christian Horner says Mercedes and Toto Wolff are finding life in Formula 1 "easier" without the former Red Bull team principal. Horner and Wolff had a huge rivalry over the last decade which culminated in the controversial 2021 season where Max Verstappen ended Mercedes' run of seven successive drivers' titles. Red Bull then became constructors' champions in 2022 as Mercedes began a difficult period, which led to more exchanges between Wolff and Horner before the latter was sacked in July 2025. messages.text: Stembridge appointed new England netball head coach

metadata.summary: Anna Stembridge has been appointed the new head coach of England through to the 2027 Netball World Cup in Sydney.
metadata.content: England netball: Anna Stembridge named new Vitality Roses head coach | Netball News | Sky Sports Skip to main content England netball: Anna Stembridge named new Vitality Roses head coach Anna Stembridge's second stint as England head coach after being in charge from 2011 to 2015; she has served as interim coach since March after Jess Thirlby's shock resignation prior to 2026 Commonwealth Games; Sky Sports pundit Tamsin Greenway and Jo Harten named on coaching staff Tuesday 20 October 2026 16:25, UK Image: Anna Stembridge has been appointed the new England Netball head coach Anna Stembridge has been appointed the new head coach of England through to the 2027 Netball World Cup in Sydney. A former Wales international with 45 caps, Stembridge has had a previous stint as England head coach from 2011 to 2015, in which the side secured a historic first series win over Australia in 2013. Having been assistant coach since September 2024, she has also served as interim head coach since March after Jess Thirlby's shock resignation four months prior to the 2026 Commonwealth Games. In Glasgow, the Vitality Roses finished fourth after losing to Australia in the bronze medal match.
